avis.texte: Awesome cleanser, skin is so smooth and glass like afterward, will last a very long time.

I’ve been using this in conjunction with the reedleshot and I am impressed. It’s great for the money and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. I have sensitive skin however, this didn’t seem to bother me.
I like this face wash. Icombinewith other VT products and I can see my skin is very smooth and nice. No one gives me my age

I would love to buy more of this but right now it's out of stock. It works well and leaves my face feeling smooth and clean. I like that you really only need a very small amount and this is a very good size bottle that will last a long time.
This soap is not harsh on my sensitive skin barrier , it leaves my skin silky smooth.

I typically don't have what I would call "sensitive" skin. However, after using this cleanser, my face started burning any time I used a regular moisturizer or sunscreen. I also started getting acne on my previously clear skin. Definitely not for me.

avis.titre: Wow ohhhh wow !!! H.G. Status right here!!!
avis.texte: Absolutely adore this face wash! And please keep in mind. I’m the kind of person that doesn’t see any reason in buying anything other than basic face wash for your face like it’s not a thing that frivolous amount of money should be spent on or have actives in it or anything like that in fact, most of the time I use the plain Cetaphil unscented face wash.. Imagine my surprise whenever I became completely and totally addicted to this one! Starting out, it’s a huge very generous size bottle and I do oil cleanse prior to washing my face to get rid of all my makeup and stuff for - because I just like the double cleanse method and for two because I don’t like to remove my makeup in my bathwater and it keeps acne at bay however, upon trying this it comes out and it’s this creamy lightweight texture doesn’t feel like anything special however, once you put on your face and you start to massage it and it shows all of it special features! It just really feels nutritious on the skin and leaves the skin feeling clean, but not tight you know like it got all the way down under the pores, but it’s still so very moisturized and feels supple to the touch prior to my toner/essence. I’m in my 40s so I need something more gentle on my face to care for my face but get it clean and this is the perfect option because it’s non-stripping it’s extremely gentle and I’ve had a couple of times where I just really wanted to push it to its limits on testing it, and I’ve actually cleansed twice with it in a

I have been wanting to try more pdrn skincare, and this is a nice vegan option using ginseng. It has a nice texture and smooths nicely into skin to clean in. I liked this enough to order the toner as well - my skin feels nice and hydrated and refreshed after using their products.

I'm a little obsessed with PDRN right now. I thought I would give this facial cleanser a try, to add more moisture to my cleansing routine. It smells like a mix between traditional bubble gum and mint. There are micro beads, which I'm not a fan of. Its rough and gritty when rubbing on your face. After wetting a small amount in my hands I massaged it into my skin before rinsing thoroughly with warm water. It didn't remove my mascara cleanly. That's OK, not all face washes do. But thus one did make my eyes and lips tingle/burn even after rinsed off. My face felt clean but tight after using. I don't feel like it was super moisturizing. It seems like it would last quite a while. Since you use such a small amount. I honestly prefer my current wash, but this is a decent one.

avis.titre: All Around Great Cleanser in a Good Size Tube
avis.texte: VT is one of my most used Kbeauty brands, their products have worked so well for me, especially the Reedle shot, I love trying new stuff from them. This is a a great cleanser- soft fun texture, large tube, and super refreshing feeling on the skin. The tube is big and shiny, it's great value, most of the other k beauty cleansers I have are 3-5 ounces. I don't need to use more than like a blueberry sized dollop, so it will last for quite awhile. The microfoam texture is really fun, it definitely has a lighter, softer feel than a regular cream to foam cleanser. It lathers into a really soft layer that almost feels cooling to me, it's a great sensorial experience all around. It has a light clean scent, refreshing and very subtle. PDRN is certainly the overhyped buzzword of the last few months, especially with these plant derived PDRNs, there's really no science backing up the claims I've seen from a lot of these brands, but this one isn't making any wild anti-aging claims at least. It is a nice hydrating ingredient. I'll use this by itself in the morning or as part of my double cleanse at night, it doesn't leave any residue and it never makes my skin feel tight or stripped. I have oily skin and it's doesn't make it shiny or wet feeling, just hydrated, clean and very soft. I will definitely be picking up another bottle of this one.

avis.titre: Can PDRN in a cleanser really make a difference?
avis.texte: I love VT Cosmetics and have used a ton of their products, so trying something from their new PDRN line was an easy yes for me. I’m also pretty deep into PDRN right now (who isn’t, amirite?). I’m in my late 30s with oily skin, and fine lines, and I have an extensive skincare routine that I’ve been refining for years. I also have a ridiculous collection of cleansers, so I have a good sense of how a good one should act. Starting off with the size of this tube, which is huge, you get so much product, and a little goes a long way. It lathers easily into a fine, creamy foam that feels soft against the skin rather than harsh or stripping. My skin felt super clean and smooth after each wash without any tight, stripped feeling I often get from aggressive cleansers. There’s no fragrance, and it caused zero irritation. I use actives daily and a cleanser that messes up my skin barrier is a problem I don’t need, so I’m glad this is gentle. My one honest thought is that I’m not sure PDRN in a rinse-off product makes contact with your face long enough to do much. The ingredient gets washed away almost immediately, so whether it has time to actually do anything is probably up for debate. That said, this is a well-formulated, gentle, effective cleanser regardless of where you land with that. Overall this is a great value given how much product you get, and it does exactly what a good daily cleanser should. I’d recommend it for anyone who wants a thorough and moisturizing clean without compro

Love it! This VT Cosmetics cleanser is really gentle on my dry skin which usually wrinkles like a prune after using any form of harsh cleanser. Honestly, even washes that claim to be gentle often leave my face looking like desert sand. Not this one! I did plug the ingredients into my skincare app and see they’re using some great ingredients in this and intentionally chose cleansing agents that are kind to the skin barrier. And you can tell. Also? This tube is huge. It’s a much better bargain than other cleansers I’ve ordered that are around the same price but not as big. The tube also comes with a tamper proof foil and sealed box which always put my mind at ease. This cleanser feels different somehow. The lather feels almost creamy. It’s a nice sensation. It’s effective as a wash but not at all drying. Once done I don’t feel the immediate panic of needing to rush for corrective toners and moisturizers. That’s a rarity for me. There’s no fragrance in this and no essential oils! It strikes me as something those with really sensitive skin might do well with. In addition to having no problematic ingredients this cleanser has a lot of beneficials ingredients oncludng botanical extracts and ceramides. There’s not a large concentration of PDRN in here but I’m not sure how helpful it’d be in a cleanser that’s quickly rinsed off anyway. Bottom line? This is a really nice cleanser that’s quickly rinsed even my aging dry skin does well with and the price is hard to beat!

avis.titre: Huge bottle, huge results. My skin barrier thanks me!!
avis.texte: This PDRN cleansing cream is unscented and super gentle. I’ve had a bit of a flare up with my acne this past week due to being on my cycle, but I found this product at the right time to start soothing and calming things down again. It contains panthenol and ceramides; two things that my skin absolutely loves because they are gentle but hard working ingredients. Because this product does contain LHA and PHA, it’s really important that I remember to wear sunscreen daily. While the cleanser is working to reinforce my skin’s barrier, I still have to do my part by protecting it from UV rays. This cleanser gets really foamy with even a minimal amount of product. I prefer to use it in the morning but I strongly believe it’s gentle enough to also use again in the evening time. My skin is combination type but leaning oily, so this cleanser was literally made just for me! I really do love VT Cosmetics. Their serums and hair products have been a huge win with me; and now I can add their cleanser to my list of things I’ve tried and love!

This cleanser has a creamy white paste texture that lathers really well. I made the mistake of using too much the first time, and it got a little ridiculous. You only need a pea-sized amount to get a full lather. It has a very faint melon scent that I found pleasant and not at all bothersome, even though I am usually quite sensitive to fragrances. After rinsing, my skin felt clean but not "stripped" or tight. I'm not sure how effective the PDRN actually is since you was it away pretty much immediately, but I do love how gentle this cleaner is.

Call me different, but I prefer having a good face wash in my shower. So simple to rinse my face, then use a cleanser or wash, rub in, give myself a good facial scrub then rinse it all off under the shower head. So much easier. And this cleanser from PDRN is a great one for this. Comes in a stand on its cap tube, meaning it's always at the cap, ready to dispense, easy to use. Seems balanced just right, not harsh, can feel it's working. Seems to have tiny scrubber beads or such in it, that really adds to the deep cleansing scrub. Can't place the scent, maybe a soft fruity gum with a twist of toothpaste? But just a hint. It works. Works well in fact. Feels like a deep cleansing. Skin feels freshened and a bit tightened after and ready for moisturizer. At almost six and a half ounces, this tube is a generous amount. only takes a little. Great to have and use. Really appreciate that they have included English in the labeling and instructions.

I actually really like this! Facial cleanser is a skincare product that's really key in a routine so it's important to choose a good one but it's entirely possible to get a great quality cleanser at an affordable price. This is a really nice cleanser that doesn't cost a lot but has great performance. I know that a lot of people will appreciate that it's fragrance-free and I really enjoy the creamy consistency that emulsifies into a gentle lather. It effectively cleans my skin and actually leaves it feeling hydrated and not stripped. I've tried quite a few products from VT Cosmetics at this point and this has become a new favorite find from the brand! Definitely check this out if you're looking for a new gentle but effective face wash.

This is a very effective cleanser for when you want to really deep clean your face, maybe daily for some but for my aging skin probably about twice a week. It creates a lot of foam when it lathers, and it has two exfoliating acids, PHA and LHA so it does really get into your pores. It does not irritate my skin, meaning I do not get any redness or rashes. However, it does make my skin briefly tingle to the point of mild stinging when I apply my moisturizing skin care products after cleansing my face with it. It's fragrance free, which is a big plus for those like me with sensitive skin or noses. I would not say that it is a moisturizing cleanser, but it doesn't seem to dry my skin out. The tube comes with a foil seal that you remove before using. That keeps the cleanser fresh and prevents any leakage while in transit.

I have tried many cleansers in my day, and this one is amongst one of the best I’ve used. My skin feels so soft and clean once I am done cleaning, and it feels incredibly gentle. The cleanser comes out as a thick cream texture and a little goes a very long way. The size of the tube is big and this cleanser will last a very long time! My skin is looking so good even after using this a handful of times. I have oily skin and I don’t feel it’s as oily as it usually is. My skin is more moisturized and doesn’t get the tightness feeling after washing either. This has been a very effective cleanser and I am so happy with the results. I do use an SPF moisturizer in the AM so I don’t burn while using this cleanser.

avis.titre: Helped nourish my skin barrier back to health!
avis.texte: I am a huge, huge, huge fan of this VT COSMETICS PDRN Barrier Cleanser. This is unbelievably gentle on my skin. My skin isn't really sensitive, but I feel as though I destroy my barrier somehow, and this was just the right amount of moisturizing, gentle, and nourishing- exactly what my skin needed. This is a very effective at cleansing my skin. It removed my mascara and foundation. I love that when I rinsed this, it didn't leave any residue or filmy feeling. My skin felt cleansed and really soft from the hydration. This is a great sized tube of PDRN Barrier Cleanser, too. The tube is designed where I had no cleanser leakage and it's easy to dispense. This is an excellent value for your money considering how great this feels on my skin. It was very gentle, and after using this for a week, my barrier seems happy and in tact again!

This has such a comfortable texture on the skin. It is gentle on my sensitive combination, oily skin while maintaining a balanced pH level. It lathers into a beautiful rich foam cleanser, but feels unique. It effectively cleanses my skin, without stripping all of my natural oils. My face doesn’t feel overly dry afterwards. The PDRN and ceramides are a bonus for maintaining my skin barrier. It’s not only effective at removing impurities but, it also doesn’t cause any irritation. The size of the tube is large and should last. I am happy with my results and recommend you give this one a try.
